component.name: RecoverAll
component.summary: Recover deleted files, lost partitions and photos

description.p: RecoverAll gets data back from disks, memory cards, USB sticks, disk images and RAIDs: from deleting a few photos by mistake to a formatted drive, deleted partitions or a damaged filesystem.

ul.li: Undelete files on NTFS, FAT12/16/32, exFAT, ext2/3/4, XFS, HFS+ and ISO 9660 with their names and folders; Btrfs, APFS and UFS through btrfs-progs and The Sleuth Kit
Deep scan: rebuild formatted, damaged and lost filesystems (NTFS without a boot sector, FAT folders after a quick format, ext files from the journal)
Find files by their signature (over 150 file types), like PhotoRec
Find deleted partitions and write them back, with an undo, like TestDisk; repair boot sectors from their backups
Recover deleted photos and videos from a camera card with a thumbnail grid
Repair damaged photos, Office documents, archives, PDFs and sound and video containers
Image failing disks (GNU ddrescue or its own imager) and assemble virtual RAIDs (0, 1, 5, 6, 10, JBOD)
